congenital_heart_disease_other.pattern: \b(congenital heart disease|adult congenital|achd|tetralogy of fallot|tof|transposition of the great arteries|tga|single ventricle|fontan|mustard|senning|ebstein(?:'s)? anomaly|coarctation|pulmonary atresia|truncus arteriosus)\b
congenital_heart_disease_other.why: Complex congenital substrate often prolongs EP/device cases beyond table features.

ventricular_septal_defect.why: Specific septal anatomy can make access, mapping, or device work more complex.

left_atrial_appendage_occlusion_or_ligat.pattern: \b(laao|left atrial appendage occlusion|watchman|amulet|atrial clip|atriaclip|left atrial appendage ligation|surgical ligation of the left atrial appendage)\b
left_atrial_appendage_occlusion_or_ligat.why: Prior LAA procedures can complicate transseptal access, mapping, and ablation workflow.

prior_cardiac_surgery.pattern: \b(prior cardiac surgery|status post cardiac surgery|s/p cardiac surgery|sternotomy|cabg|coronary artery bypass|valve replacement|valve repair|mitral valve repair|aortic valve replacement|tricuspid valve repair|maze procedure|surgical maze)\b
prior_cardiac_surgery.why: Postsurgical anatomy and adhesions often increase procedural complexity and duration.

multiple_or_abandoned_leads.pattern: \b(multiple leads|abandoned lead|abandoned leads|retained lead|retained leads|extra lead|lead burden|lead revision|lead revisions|lead extraction|lead extractions)\b
multiple_or_abandoned_leads.why: Higher lead burden or abandoned hardware can lengthen implant/revision/extraction cases.

leadless_pacemaker_or_subcutaneous_icd.why: Nonstandard device systems may signal challenging revisions, upgrades, or extraction planning.

left_atrial_enlargement_or_dilation.pattern: \b(left atrial enlargement|left atrial dilatation|left atrial dilation|severely enlarged left atrium|marked left atrial enlargement|la enlargement|la dilation|la dilatation)\b
left_atrial_enlargement_or_dilation.why: Advanced atrial remodeling is associated with longer AF/atrial arrhythmia procedures.

frailty_or_wheelchair_bound.why: Functional limitation can slow transport, positioning, and peri-procedural workflow.
